tools.name: police.check_action
tools.title: Check whether an action would pass
tools.description: ADVISORY. Judges a stated action against one role template and answers allow, deny or hold_for_manual_approval, naming the first rule that fired. It never signs, moves or spends. Amounts are integers of USD CENTS ($10.00 is 1000), never dollars.

action_kind.description: The signing method / action kind, e.g. "transfer_stable". Absent is refused fail-closed where a rule reads it.

chain.description: Chain id, e.g. "aeredium". On a crossing this is the SOURCE chain, and it is the chain every rule is judged on.

to_chain.description: For bridge_stable: the chain the crossing delivers on. Reported, not judged — every rule is judged on the source chain — and NOT part of the receipt’s action hash.

venue.description: Execution venue id, e.g. "uniswap_v3", where the role names venues.

function.description: Contract function class, e.g. "swap", where the role names functions.

amount_usd_cents.description: The transaction amount as a whole number of USD CENTS. $10.00 is 1000. Fractions and dollar figures are refused.

child_wallet_id.description: Your agent child wallet id. Required for a RECEIPT: the wallet always names it, so a receipt without it could never match. The verdict itself does not need it.

to_address.description: The destination address, where the action has one. ON A CROSSING it is empty or the agent’s own address — a crossing delivers to itself — and anything else is refused before the action is judged. Part of the receipt’s action hash; lower-cased before hashing.

counterparty_address.description: The counterparty address, where the action has one. Part of the receipt’s action hash.

contract_address.description: The contract address, where the action has one. FOR A TRADE THIS IS THE DESTINATION the owner’s list is checked against — the venue’s contract — so a trade without it is refused; with venue best_direct leave it empty. FOR A CROSSING it is the issuer’s bridge contract on the source chain, checked against the same list. Part of the receipt’s action hash.

method_selector.description: The contract method selector, where the action has one. Part of the receipt’s action hash.

spent_today_usd_cents.description: Stated context: USD cents this credential has already spent today. Unstated is assumed zero, and the verdict says so.

transactions_today.description: Stated context: transactions this credential has already made today. Unstated is assumed zero, and the verdict says so.

slippage_bps.description: Declared maximum slippage, in basis points.

price_deviation_bps.description: Oracle-versus-execution price deviation, in basis points.

simulation_passed.description: The dry-run simulation verdict you expect. Produced at execution; absent fails closed.

oracle_check_passed.description: The oracle sanity verdict you expect. Produced at execution; absent fails closed.

amount.description: NOT ACCEPTED. Present only so an amount sent in dollars is refused rather than silently ignored.

amount_usd.description: NOT ACCEPTED. Present only so an amount sent in dollars is refused rather than silently ignored.

amount_dollars.description: NOT ACCEPTED. Present only so an amount sent in dollars is refused rather than silently ignored.
